_about: How a town on a streamed map is laid out (lane B5, scripts/world/big/big_towns.gd); a map's town names one by its style. Streets run along the town's long side every street_every_m, buildings stand on lots of lot_m along both sides of each street (fill: the share of lots built on), each a kit.json entry picked by weight. extras: on an empty lot, the chance of each kit piece instead (rubble, walls, tank traps). The town's own damage range (maps.json) sets how ruined each building is.
